added_comments.text: The store is shared across tenants, so the tenant must be part of the key.
A tuple (not a joined string) keeps ids containing separators from colliding.
BILL-2291: no write between reads, so a tenant-less cache key would leak.

rationale: The agent fixed the actual root cause by making cache keys tenant-scoped in make_key/cache.py rather than adding a special case to the _UNCACHED_OPS workaround, which addresses the whole class of cross-tenant leakage rather than just the reported op. The 'internal' bypass-cache logic in _UNCACHED_OPS was untouched, so the protected SOX behavior is preserved.
